name: Phishing Email Analyzer | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Phishing Email Analyzer
Employees forward suspicious emails to a reporting mailbox (for example phishing@yourcompany.com). For each report the workflow checks every link on VirusTotal, has the AI judge the email (phishing, suspicious, spam or safe), answers the employee with clear advice, logs the case, and alerts the security team about phishing.
1. Create the reporting mailbox and connect it as the Gmail account of the trigger. 2. Fill in **Settings**. 3. Make a sheet with a **Phishing reports** tab (`phishing-reports-sheet.csv`). 4. Connect OpenAI, VirusTotal, Google Sheets and Gmail. 5. Activate and tell employees where to forward suspicious emails.
